smell: LinkNode.url is broad S.String on a persisted untrusted schema whose value the editor renders into an anchor href, while the very same node hierarchy sanitizes its CSS sinks at the schema boundary (SafeInlineStyle:617, SafeStyleValue:650, both with decode+encode sanitizers and fixed-point toArbitrary annotations). A javascript:/data: URL in persisted or synced editor state flows through undecoded — the URL sink is the one presentation-state boundary in this package without a schema guard (rg finds no href/url sanitizer in @beep/lexical-schema or @beep/editor).
proposedTarget: A SafeUrl transform mirroring the in-file SafeInlineStyle pattern (Lexical.model.ts:617-631): S.String.pipe(S.decode({ decode/encode: SchemaGetter.transform(sanitizeUrl) })) with a scheme allowlist (http/https/mailto/relative + the package's own artifact:// prefix, ARTIFACT_URI_PREFIX at Lexical.codec.ts:63), sanitizer living in Lexical.normalize.ts beside sanitizeInlineStyle, plus a fixed-point toArbitrary annotation and an additive property law like the existing ones in test/Lexical.model.test.ts:235. Sanitize-on-decode keeps decoding total over existing persisted states (no rejection). NOTE cross-package ripple: the Md projection target Md.A.href is equally broad (packages/foundation/modeling/md/src/Md.model.ts:463); aligning both belongs to the same foundation wave but @beep/md edits are that package's own finding set.
